layers.label: Authority
layers.description: Where canonical decisions and lifecycle state live.

layers.label: Interfaces
layers.description: Local, remote, agentic, and typed entry surfaces.

modes.label: Executive Flow
modes.description: Idea to production under governed evidence.

modes.label: Authority Map
modes.description: Who owns state, decisions, rules, evidence, and execution.

modes.label: Interface Map
modes.description: CLI, REST, MCP, SDK, command/event runtime, and protocol boundaries.

modes.label: Evidence Graph
modes.description: Artifact lineage from business intent to audited gate decisions.

modes.label: Agentic Mode
modes.description: Governed AI execution through MCP, Agent Runtime, policy, memory, and adapters.

modes.label: Satellite Mode
modes.description: Hub-and-spoke inheritance and upstream learning from products such as UMS.

modes.label: Integration Mode
modes.description: Provider-neutral composition through ports, adapters, and anti-corruption layers.

nodes.label: Business Intent
nodes.summary: The product idea, stakeholder need, hypothesis, ROI, and decision trigger that starts governance.
nodes.authority: Business stakeholders approve intent, but Evolith governs the evidence chain.
nodes.consumes: Market context, customer hypothesis, business trigger.
nodes.exposes: Discovery input, assumptions, KPI targets, capability questions.

nodes.label: Humans
nodes.summary: Architects, engineers, product roles, and approvers interacting through Tracker, CLI, and reviews.
nodes.authority: Human accountability remains required for critical decisions, exceptions, and vision changes.
nodes.consumes: Dashboards, gate verdicts, CLI results, architecture docs.
nodes.exposes: Approvals, evidence, decisions, PRs, ADR proposals.

nodes.label: AI Agents
nodes.summary: LLM or autonomous agents that execute bounded activities through MCP or Agent Runtime.
nodes.authority: Agents execute work but do not approve gates or rewrite governance.
nodes.consumes: Approved context, tools, prompts, policy boundaries.
nodes.exposes: Tool calls, artifacts, trace events, candidate evidence.

nodes.label: Executive Scorecards
nodes.summary: Executive and compliance view of adherence, evidence completeness, drift, exceptions, and delivery readiness.
nodes.authority: Dashboard rendering is not authority; trusted metrics depend on Evolith governance records.
nodes.consumes: Tracker state, Core evaluations, metrics definitions, provider facts.
nodes.exposes: Health scores, adherence, readiness, executive narrative.

nodes.label: Evolith Tracker
nodes.summary: SaaS SDLC orchestrator and auditor. Owns canonical runtime governance state, approvals, exceptions, and phase decisions.
nodes.authority: Canonical owner of tenant, product, phase, gate decision, evidence acceptance, approvals, exceptions, and audit state.
nodes.consumes: Core technical evaluations, provider facts, user approvals, agent trace events.
nodes.exposes: Gate decisions, phase transitions, evidence graph, audit history, executive views.

nodes.label: Canonical Evidence Graph
nodes.summary: Traceable graph from intent to artifacts, criteria, evaluation, decision, source provider, actor, model, commit, and release.
nodes.authority: Tracker records acceptance and final decisions; Core supplies technical evaluation facts.
nodes.consumes: Artifacts, provider identifiers, actor context, ruleset versions, evaluation results.
nodes.exposes: Audit-ready traceability and lineage.

nodes.label: Architecture Board
nodes.summary: Human governance authority for Core ADRs, upstream promotions, universal standards, and strategic decisions.
nodes.authority: Approves universal Core evolution and accepted architecture trade-offs.
nodes.consumes: Product evidence, ADR candidates, maturity signals, exceptions.
nodes.exposes: Accepted ADRs, rejected proposals, promotion decisions.

nodes.label: Discovery
nodes.summary: Product discovery, problem framing, build-versus-compose analysis, and Business Sign-Off.
nodes.authority: Tracker records the binding gate decision after authorized review.
nodes.consumes: Discovery canvas, assumptions, ROI, alternatives.
nodes.exposes: Business Sign-Off evidence and gate outcome.

nodes.label: Spec-Driven Design
nodes.summary: Functional intent, contracts, ADRs, architecture baseline, and Design Baseline gate.
nodes.authority: Architecture and product governance approve the baseline.
nodes.consumes: Functional stories, contracts, ADRs, risk analysis.
nodes.exposes: Design Baseline gate result.

nodes.label: Construction
nodes.summary: Implementation work linked to source, pipeline, specifications, and drift traceability.
nodes.authority: Construction gate policy and authorized approvers decide readiness.
nodes.consumes: Source changes, linked work, CI, DoD, drift results.
nodes.exposes: Successful Build evidence.

nodes.label: QA and Integration
nodes.summary: Regression, security, contracts, exceptions, and RC Stamped readiness.
nodes.authority: Quality governance accepts or blocks release candidate evidence.
nodes.consumes: Test summary, coverage, security, contract results.
nodes.exposes: RC Stamped gate outcome.

nodes.label: Release Planner
nodes.summary: Rollout, operational readiness, rollback, observability, and Production Live approval.
nodes.authority: Operations and release governance authorize production.
nodes.consumes: Release plan, observability, rollback, deployment evidence.
nodes.exposes: Production Live gate outcome.

nodes.label: Agent Runtime
nodes.summary: Ports-and-adapters mediation for governed multi-step agent execution.
nodes.authority: Owns execution trace for agent work; does not approve gates or redefine Core rules.
nodes.consumes: Commands, approvals, policies, Core evaluations, adapters.
nodes.exposes: AgentRuntimeResult, SSE events, trace publication.

nodes.label: Smart CLI
nodes.summary: Local enforcement surface for humans, CI, satellite scaffolding, validation, gates, ADRs, and MCP delegation.
nodes.authority: Produces local evaluation output and exit codes; final product decisions remain outside CLI.
nodes.consumes: Workspace files, evolith.yaml, corpus, SDK remote calls.
nodes.exposes: Console output, JSON envelope, exit code, scaffolded artifacts.

nodes.label: Core API
nodes.summary: REST exposure layer for stateless technical governance evaluation.
nodes.authority: Owns technical evaluation only; Tracker owns binding product decisions.
nodes.consumes: EvaluationContext, evidence, workspaceRef, corpus, cache.
nodes.exposes: ADR-0073 envelopes, RFC 9457 problems, reference reads.

nodes.label: MCP Server
nodes.summary: Model Context Protocol gateway for governed tools, resources, prompts, ABAC, audit, and metrics.
nodes.authority: Owns MCP tool execution contract; caller owns conversation state.
nodes.consumes: Tool inputs, resources, prompts, auth context, corpus.
nodes.exposes: MCP result envelopes, resources, prompts, audit metrics.

nodes.label: Evolith SDK
nodes.summary: Typed client surface for Core API and runtime integration.
nodes.authority: Client boundary only; domain decisions remain in Core/Tracker.
nodes.consumes: Typed requests, configuration, auth.
nodes.exposes: Typed responses and integration helpers.

nodes.label: Anti-Corruption Layers
nodes.summary: Replaceable adapters that prevent external provider schemas from contaminating the canonical domain model.
nodes.authority: Translate and validate; do not decide phase authority.
nodes.consumes: Provider schemas, external identifiers, webhooks.
nodes.exposes: Canonical artifacts, evidence, provider status.

nodes.label: Evolith Core Constitution
nodes.summary: Living reference corpus: ADRs, standards, taxonomies, rulesets, schemas, gates, topologies, contracts, and templates.
nodes.authority: Canonical source of reusable engineering governance definitions.
nodes.consumes: Accepted ADRs, upstream lessons, architecture board decisions.
nodes.exposes: Rules, standards, blueprints, schemas, phase gates.

nodes.label: Rulesets and OPA Policies
nodes.summary: Native TypeScript rules and OPA policies used for executable governance evaluation.
nodes.authority: Machine-readable enforcement truth; must preserve dual-engine parity for architectural rules.
nodes.consumes: Core rules, schemas, test fixtures.
nodes.exposes: Policy decisions, violations, remediation signals.

nodes.label: Artifacts and Templates
nodes.summary: Discovery canvas, OpenAPI contracts, YAML templates, evidence schemas, release notes, and SDLC records.
nodes.authority: Structured evidence format; acceptance remains with Tracker/gates.
nodes.consumes: Phase requirements, schemas, product context.
nodes.exposes: Reusable templates and validatable evidence artifacts.

nodes.label: Satellite Products
nodes.summary: Products such as UMS and product repositories that inherit, adopt, specialize, and propose upstream improvements.
nodes.authority: Local product decisions stay local unless promoted by Architecture Board.
nodes.consumes: Core rules, blueprints, gates, templates.
nodes.exposes: Implementation evidence, lessons, ADR candidates, conformance signals.

nodes.label: GitHub / CI
nodes.summary: External repository and CI/CD platform that holds source, PRs, commits, and pipeline evidence.
nodes.authority: Owns source and pipeline facts; Evolith decides whether facts satisfy governance.
nodes.consumes: Repository changes, workflow configuration.
nodes.exposes: Commits, PRs, checks, artifacts, webhooks.

nodes.label: External Tools
nodes.summary: Jira, Linear, Trello, observability, analytics, CI/CD, deployment, security, and collaboration providers.
nodes.authority: Produce operational facts and evidence; never approve phase transitions independently.
nodes.consumes: Commands, exports, integration settings.
nodes.exposes: Work items, telemetry, analytics, tool events.

nodes.label: Hermes / LLM Engines
nodes.summary: Replaceable agent execution engine behind Agent Runtime ports.
nodes.authority: Executor only; no governance authority.
nodes.consumes: Approved context, prompts, tools.
nodes.exposes: Model/agent responses and tool requests.

nodes.label: Runtime Memory
nodes.summary: Working memory for agent execution. It is not Tracker canonical lifecycle state.
nodes.authority: Runtime-scoped context only.
nodes.consumes: Conversation and task context.
nodes.exposes: Working memory for runtime steps.

scenarios.label: E2E idea to production
scenarios.description: Business intent becomes a governed production decision.

scenarios.label: Governed agent execution
scenarios.description: An AI agent works through MCP and Agent Runtime without bypassing policy.

scenarios.label: Satellite upstream learning
scenarios.description: A satellite inherits Core rules and proposes evidence-backed improvements upstream.

scenarios.label: Provider composition
scenarios.description: External tools exchange facts through ACLs while Evolith retains governance authority.
